Hit strip & download — the SHA-256 fingerprint proves pixels are unchanged

name: Password Breach Checker
tagline: Has this password been breached? — it never leaves your tab
detail: Check any password against 800M+ breached credentials via Have I Been Pwned's k-anonymity API — only 5 hash characters leave the browser.
keywords: password breach pwned haveibeenpwned hibp leak check security k-anonymity
about: Type a password; your browser hashes it with SHA-1 and sends only the first 5 characters of the hash to Have I Been Pwned's free Pwned Passwords range API. The API returns every breached hash suffix sharing that prefix — about 800 candidates — and the match happens locally, in your tab. The password itself, and even the full hash, never travel the network. A hit shows exactly how many breaches contained the password; a miss means it isn't in the public corpus (necessary, not sufficient — still prefer long, unique, manager-generated passwords).

Zero storage — no cookies, no localStorage, nothing logged

Press Check for breaches (or Enter)
A hit names the breach count — change that password everywhere; a miss means it's not in the public corpus

goodFor: Auditing your own passwords, checking a new password before adopting it, demonstrating why reused passwords fall first.
engine: WebCrypto SHA-1 + HIBP Pwned Passwords range API
verified: Known-breached password returns its exact public count; k-anonymity prefix verified on the wire

guideSteps.result: Mathematical k-anonymity verification you can confirm in Browser DevTools Network tab.
